rambling-racer.title: Rambling Racer - Master the Drift, Conquer the Road
rambling-racer.slogan: Perform spectacular drifts with the Rambling Racer and prove your excellent alignment skills.
rambling-racer.description: Rambling Racer is ready to challenge your improvisation skills, professional drivers. Prepare for breathtaking drifts on a thrilling floating road. Each turn will be an extreme test of your top navigation ability. This endless running gameplay promises to feature heart-pounding but also appealing experiences. You will control a small car through continuous, sharp roads. Join and see how good a player you are with your highest score!

HomeFeatures.gameTitle: Rambling Racer - Master the Drift, Conquer the Road
HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Rambling Racer is an endless running game where you control a car through continuous, sharp roads. The difficulty increases as you progress, challenging your navigation skills.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Control the car running at a constant speed along the road.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Hold down the mouse button to drift to the right.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Change hands to return to the original state.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Enter a magical world with a beautiful meteor shower.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Easy to learn but requires practice to master.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: The colors and design of the main road change continuously.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Use earned coins to unlock a variety of other vehicles in the in-game shop.
